tasks.instruction:
W każdą z luk wpisz odpowiednie słowo przekształcając wyraz podany na końcu zdania drukowanymi literami. Wymagana jest pełna poprawność gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych słów.

Przykład: The __________ (SERVE) in this restaurant was absolutely appalling. — prawidłowa odpowiedź: SERVICE

items.sentence: After the renovation our old school was almost __________: nobody could believe it was the same building.
These new shoes are so __________ that I can hardly walk in them.
When the singer walked onto the stage right in front of us, my sister was completely __________: she just stood there with her mouth open.
He went red with __________ when he realised that everyone on the bus had heard him singing.
The flood caused __________ damage to the old church, and it will never look the same again.
Stop being so __________! You are fourteen, not four.
My brother is the most __________ person I know: it takes him twenty minutes to choose an ice-cream flavour.
The view from the top of the mountain was __________: I will remember it for the rest of my life.
Mum shook her head in __________ when she saw the mess in my room.
I __________ deleted all my holiday photos when I was trying to free up some space on my phone.
The __________ between the twins is amazing: even their own parents sometimes mix them up.
I lost three points for __________ mistakes, even though I knew all the answers!
In winter the mountain village is __________ by car, so food and medicine arrive by helicopter.
Her English __________ is excellent: everyone thinks she grew up in London.
We have just moved to a quiet __________ with lots of trees and hardly any traffic.
The bad weather was a real __________ to the rescue team, who could not use their helicopter.
The shop assistant became __________ when the boy kept looking around nervously and putting things into his pockets.
It was really __________ of you to play loud music while your brother was revising for his exams.
My brother's __________ is unbelievable: he spent the whole weekend lying on the sofa.
Our guide was very __________: she could answer every question we asked about the castle.
My cousin is very __________: she started her own cake business when she was only sixteen.
Her __________ to help others makes her a wonderful friend.
The difference in price between the two phones is __________, so just buy the one you like more.
My dad is an __________: he designs bridges and motorways.
The view from the castle tower was __________ beautiful: we could see for miles.
Grandpa told us a __________ story about his first day at school, and we couldn't stop laughing.
The prices in the new café are __________ high: eight pounds for a small glass of orange juice is a joke!
The sudden __________ of the dinosaurs about 66 million years ago is still a bit of a mystery.
The judges praised the __________ of her story: nobody had ever written anything like it.
Our guide spoke so __________ about the old castle that nobody wanted the tour to end.

tasks.instruction: Wykorzystując podane słowa (wyróżnione pogrubionym drukiem), należy uzupełnić luki w zdaniach tak, aby zachować sens zdania wyjściowego. Można wpisać do sześciu słów, wliczając w to wyraz wymagany. Słów podanych nie wolno w żaden sposób zmieniać. Niedopuszczalne są formy skrócone (isn't, won't, would've itd.). Konieczna jest pełna poprawność gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych fraz.

items.original: I am hungry now because I did not have breakfast.
items.transformed: I would not be hungry now _________ breakfast.
items.answer: if I had had / if I had eaten

items.original: Everyone expects you to be at school by eight o'clock.
items.transformed: You _________ at school by eight o'clock.

items.original: I have two older brothers. They both play in the school band.
items.transformed: I have two older brothers, _________ play in the school band.

items.original: The box was so heavy that I could not lift it.
items.transformed: The box was _________ lift.

items.original: I had no idea that my friends were planning a surprise party for me.
items.transformed: _________ my friends were planning a surprise party for me.
items.answer: Little did I know that / Little did I know / Little did I realise that / Little did I realise / Little did I realize that / Little did I realize / Little did I suspect that / Little did I suspect

items.original: 'Don't swim too far from the beach,' the lifeguard said to us.
items.transformed: The lifeguard _________ too far from the beach.
items.answer: warned us not to swim / warned us against swimming

items.original: It was Kasia's fault that the vase got broken.
items.transformed: Kasia _________ the broken vase.
items.answer: was to blame for / was the one to blame for

items.original: I cannot tolerate my brother's loud music any longer.
items.transformed: I cannot _________ my brother's loud music any longer.

items.original: Everyone was surprised when Tom won the race.
items.transformed: _________ surprise, Tom won the race.
items.answer: Much to everyone's / Much to everybody's

items.original: You can borrow my bike, but only if you bring it back by six.
items.transformed: You can borrow my bike _________ it back by six.
items.answer: as long as you bring / so long as you bring / as long as you give / so long as you give

items.original: Nobody in my class is taller than Kuba.
items.transformed: Kuba is _________ in my class.
items.answer: the tallest boy / the tallest pupil / the tallest student / the tallest person / the tallest child / the tallest

items.original: When I saw my dad's new haircut, I couldn't stop laughing.
items.transformed: When I saw my dad's new haircut, I _________.
items.answer: could not help laughing / could not help but laugh

items.original: 'Do you like pizza?' my new classmate said to me.
items.transformed: My new classmate _________ pizza.
items.answer: asked me if I liked / asked me whether I liked / asked if I liked / asked whether I liked

items.original: The film was not as good as I had expected.
items.transformed: The film did not _________ expectations.
items.answer: live up to my / live up to

items.original: I don't know how to solve this maths problem.
items.transformed: I have _________ this maths problem.
items.answer: no idea how to solve / no idea how I can solve / no idea how I should solve

items.original: Kasia is the only person who can help us.
items.transformed: Nobody _________ us.
items.answer: but Kasia can help / but Kasia is able to help

items.original: There is no milk left in the fridge.
items.transformed: We have _________ milk.

items.original: You must not open this door under any circumstances.
items.transformed: Under _________ this door.
items.answer: no circumstances must you open / no circumstances should you open / no circumstances are you to open / no circumstances can you open

items.original: Do you think I could borrow your pen for a moment?
items.transformed: I _________ borrow your pen for a moment.
items.answer: wonder if I could / wonder whether I could / wonder if I might / wonder whether I might

items.original: Everybody knows that this beach is the cleanest in Poland.
items.transformed: This beach _________ the cleanest in Poland.

items.original: I checked the train times on the internet.
items.transformed: I _________ on the internet.
items.answer: looked up the train times / looked the train times up

items.original: I'm sure it will rain later: look at those dark clouds.
items.transformed: It is _________ later: look at those dark clouds.

items.original: I can't wait for the summer holidays.
items.transformed: I am really _________ the summer holidays.

items.original: My friend persuaded me to join the drama club.
items.transformed: My friend _________ the drama club.

items.original: I will never forget the day. I met my best friend on that day.
items.transformed: I will never forget the day _________ my best friend.
items.answer: when I met / when I first met

items.original: Imagine you could live anywhere in the world. Where would you live?
items.transformed: _________ anywhere in the world, where would you live?
items.answer: Supposing you could live / Supposing that you could live / Supposing you were able to live

items.original: My brother is really good at chess.
items.transformed: My brother has _________ chess.
items.answer: a real talent for / a talent for / a great talent for / a real talent for playing / a talent for playing / a great talent for playing

items.original: It is very likely that the match will be cancelled.
items.transformed: In _________ be cancelled.

items.original: Sam is the best football player in our team.
items.transformed: Sam plays football better _________ our team.
items.answer: than anyone else in / than anyone in

items.original: Grandma is very proud of her garden.
items.transformed: Grandma _________ her garden.
items.answer: takes great pride in / takes a lot of pride in / takes pride in

tasks.instruction: Uzupełnij lukę w każdym ze zdań, wybierając jedną poprawną odpowiedź z zaproponowanych możliwości A) – D).

items.stem: My bike isn't where I left it. It must __________ while I was in the shop.
I __________ to the zoo since I was a little kid.
You've hit the __________ on the head: that's exactly what the problem is.
Our teacher asked us __________ the homework.
The fire alarm went __________ in the middle of our maths test, so we all had to leave the building.
The new student, __________ we had heard so much, turned out to be really shy.
By the time we get to the cinema, the film __________, so we'll miss the beginning.
She made a __________ effort to be friendly to the new girl in her class.
When Grandma heard that I had won the competition, she was over the __________.
__________ you need any help with your project, just give me a call.
__________ it not for your help, I would still be stuck on the first question.
You're coming to Ola's party on Saturday, __________?
I __________ across some old photos of my parents while I was tidying the attic.
Our teacher turned a __________ eye to our chatting because it was the last day of term.
I wish I __________ more time to finish this project.
__________ by the noise, the baby started to cry.
The new head teacher is very strict, so we had better be on our best __________.
The football match was called off because of __________ rain.
I'll never forget __________ the sea for the first time when I was four.
__________ as it may seem, the story is completely true.
When I was little, I __________ be afraid of the dark.
The new animated film got __________ reviews: the critics loved it.
The woman __________ car was stolen went straight to the police.
If I hadn't stayed up so late last night, I __________ so tired now.
The plane __________ off an hour late because of the fog.
Only when I got home __________ that I had lost my wallet.
These new trainers cost an arm and a __________, but they are really comfortable.
Everyone knew who would win: the result of the match was a __________ conclusion.
You __________ have told me about the party: I would have bought Ola a present!
__________ the film before, I knew exactly how it would end.
